extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from local XML/PDF sections, figures, and captions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ChDode is supported as a membrane-active peptide that forms proton/ion-conducting pores in model membranes without wholesale membrane lysis.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is shown in model membrane systems; do not generalize to all bacterial killing without the activity context.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ChDode and ChMAP-28 show synergistic antibacterial action with increased E. coli membrane permeability in the combined condition.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The ChMAP-28 exact sequence remains database-derived in this paper, so identity caution is kept in the database layer.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ChDode has only weak cell-free translation inhibition at concentrations above its MIC, so the ribosome-targeting mechanism is not promoted for ChDode.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a negative/limiting context claim, not a direct antimicrobial mechanism assignment.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NMR/CD/FTIR evidence supports beta-structural ChDode/PcDode conformations and ChDode tetramerization in DPC micelles as structure-function context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural context supports but does not by itself prove bacterial-cell mechanism.

semantic_quality_control.overclaim_prevention: Direct mechanism labels are limited to source-located membrane/permeability experiments; translation and structure are kept as context.
